gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma IDH (Isocitrate Dehydrogenase) Wildtype; Astrocytoma, Grade III
GBM Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH)-wildtype Grade 4 which may include secondary GBMs (i.e., those that progress from low-grade gliomas).

candidate_evidence.quote: The primary objective of Phase 2 is to assess the efficacy of zedoresertib at the RD for further development in combination with TMZ, compared to the standard of care (SOC) in adult participants with GBM.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study of Zedoresertib (Debio 0123) in Combination With Temozolomide in Adult Participants With Recurrent or Progressive Glioblastoma and of Zedoresertib (Debio 0123) in Combination With Temozolomide and Radiotherapy in Adult Participants With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: The pharmacokinetics (PK) of zedoresertib and its metabolite will be evaluated in plasma.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive intermittent zedoresertib, escalating doses along with temozolomide (TMZ) in each 28-day cycle for up to 2 years.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive intermittent zedoresertib, escalating doses along with TMZ and concomitant administration of radiotherapy (RT) for up to 6 weeks.

Participants must have a histopathologically proven diagnosis of GBM, IDH-wildtype Grade 4 WHO 2021

coder_notes: Phase 1 Arm A also enrols IDH-mutant grade 3 astrocytoma, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named; other arms are IDH-wildtype GBM only (WHO 2021). Arms B/C (newly diagnosed, with RT) and Arm A/expansion/Phase 2 (recurrent) give treatment_setting both. Phase 2 is described as compared to standard of care but no SOC comparator arm is registered; coded control_arm_from_other_arms no. pCDC2 sample type not stated (tumour/blood unclear) but it is a stated PD marker of WEE1 inhibition. IDH-wildtype row reflects GBM definition for expansion/Phase 2 cohorts only; Arms B and C also require IDH-wildtype GBM.
